title: Quasi-coherent algebra image factorization on smooth tests
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $\mathcal X$ be an algebraic stack over $k$ [def-sfb-algebraic-moduli-stack], and let $u:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be a morphism of arbitrary quasi-coherent commutative $\mathcal O_{\mathcal X}$-algebras [def-sfb-stack-quasi-coherent-algebra]. There is a quasi-coherent commutative algebra $\mathcal C$ and a factorization $\mathcal A\xrightarrow{q}\mathcal C\xrightarrow{j}\mathcal B$ of $u$ such that $q$ is a surjection in the big-fppf-sheaf sense and $j$ is the image inclusion in the category of quasi-coherent modules. For every smooth scheme test $a:T\to\mathcal X$, restriction identifies this factorization with the ordinary image factorization of the morphism of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_T$-algebras $a^*\mathcal A\to a^*\mathcal B$; in particular $\mathcal C(T)\to\mathcal B(T)$ is injective. More generally, for every smooth morphism $a:Z\to\mathcal X$ from an algebraic stack, the induced map $\Gamma(Z,a^*\mathcal C)\to\Gamma(Z,a^*\mathcal B)$ is injective. Here restrictions and global sections use [def-sfb-stack-quasi-coherent-algebra], and quasi-coherent tensor pullback agrees with precomposition restriction as in [lem-sfb-stack-quasi-coherent-scheme-restriction]. Smoothness means smoothness on scheme charts [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. No Noetherian, finite-generation, quasi-compactness or injectivity hypothesis on $u$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 06WV (lemma-quasi-coherent-algebraic-stack), (1)--(4): the quasi-coherent abelian category and its right exact inclusion into big-fppf module sheaves. Smooth-test image computation and preservation of image monomorphisms: stacks-cohomology.tex Tags 076X (lemma-flat-pullback-quasi-coherent) and 0GQF (lemma-quasi-coherent-check-exact); smooth chart pullback is exact. The algebra structure on the module image is induced by multiplication and the unit. This is not an assertion that the image inclusion is injective on arbitrary nonflat big-site tests.

proof.text: Forget the algebra structures. In the abelian category $\operatorname{QCoh}(\mathcal X)$ form $K=\ker u$ and $C=\operatorname{coker}(K\to A)$, with $u=jq$, $q:A\to C$ epi and $j:C\to B$ mono. This is the image factorization: the abelian coimage-image identification gives $C=\operatorname{Im}u$. The existing flat-atlas/cokernel theorem identifies the cokernel $q$ with the ambient fppf module-sheaf cokernel, so $q$ is locally surjective for fppf coverings. It does not assert that $j$ is mono in that ambient category.

source.place: 06WV(2)--(4), categorical image and right exact inclusion

proof.text: Construct the algebra on $C$. The structure module and all tensor products here are quasi-coherent by the flat-atlas theorem. Write $i:K\to A$ and $h=q\mu_A:A\otimes A\to C$. Since $u$ is an algebra map, $jh(i\otimes1)=\mu_B(ui\otimes u)=0$, and monicity of $j$ in quasi-coherent modules gives $h(i\otimes1)=0$; likewise $h(1\otimes i)=0$. Tensor preserves cokernels, so first descend $h$ through $q\otimes1$ to $C\otimes A$. Its composite with $1\otimes i$ is zero after precomposition with the epi $q\otimes1_K$, hence is zero. Descend again through $1\otimes q$ to a multiplication $\mu_C:C\otimes C\to C$. Define $\eta_C=q\eta_A$. The equations $\mu_C(q\otimes q)=q\mu_A$ and $\eta_C=q\eta_A$ make $q$ multiplicative and unital. Associativity, commutativity and the unit identities follow by precomposition with $q^{\otimes3}$, $q^{\otimes2}$ and $q$, respectively; these are epi because tensor preserves cokernels, and their two sides reduce to the corresponding identities in $A$. Similarly precomposing with $q^{\otimes2}$ and $q$ proves $j\mu_C=\mu_B(j\otimes j)$ and $j\eta_C=\eta_B$. Thus $A\to C\to B$ is a factorization by commutative algebras with the underlying module maps of step 1.

Let $a:T\to\mathcal X$ be smooth with $T$ a scheme. Exact smooth restriction preserves $K=\ker u$ and $C=\operatorname{coker}(K\to A)$; hence $C_a$ is the quasi-coherent module image of $u_a:A_a\to B_a$, with its quotient and inclusion. Kernels and cokernels of maps of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_T$-modules, formed in all $\mathcal O_T$-modules, are quasi-coherent, so this is also the image in all $\mathcal O_T$-modules. The scheme-test comparison identifies structure modules, tensors and these maps. The ordinary scheme algebra-image theorem puts the inherited image algebra structure on that same module. It agrees with the multiplication just constructed: both become $q_a\mu_{A_a}$ after the locally surjective map $q_a\otimes q_a$, and both units equal $q_a\eta_{A_a}$. Consequently the entire restricted algebra factorization is the ordinary image factorization. Its inclusion is injective on every Zariski open, in particular on $T$. By $F(a)=\Gamma(T,F_a)$ this proves $C(T)\to B(T)$ injective.

source.place: 076X and 0GQF; scheme algebra image: sheaves.tex 0087 and modules.tex 01AG; kernels and cokernels of quasi-coherent modules: schemes.tex 01IC

proof.text: Finally let $a:Z\to\mathcal X$ be smooth with $Z$ an algebraic stack. By the scheme-restriction lemma, precomposition $a^*$ is the quasi-coherent tensor pullback, so $a^*C$ and $a^*B$ are quasi-coherent algebras and exact smooth pullback makes $a^*j$ mono in $\operatorname{QCoh}(Z)$. Choose a smooth surjective scheme atlas $p:U\to Z$. Exact smooth scheme restriction makes $p^*a^*j$ a monomorphism of ordinary quasi-coherent modules on $U$, so its map on sections is injective; by $F(p)=\Gamma(U,F_p)$ these are the sections over $U$ used below. If $s,t\in\Gamma(Z,a^*C)$ have equal images, their pullbacks to $U$ agree by this injectivity. The smooth-cover section-descent theorem applied to the quasi-coherent algebra $a^*C$ says that equality can be checked on this atlas, so $s=t$. This proves the final injectivity assertion without assuming any big-fppf image inclusion is sectionwise injective on nonflat tests.
